mid.name: Torment Pulse
mid.annotation: Great damage over the course of a game/fight. Good for tankiness and farming. Gets us our 4.8k spirit investment. I personally prefer it over Spirit Snatch as it does better in longer trades.

mid.name: Lifestrike

mid.name: Hunter's Aura

mid.name: Reactive Barrier

mid.name: Spirit Snatch

late.name: Arctic Blast
late.annotation: Really great item, great for catching people and for clearing waves in cat form.

late.name: Transcendent Cooldown
late.annotation: Great item once you have 2 actives. It also makes Torment Pulse tick faster!

late.name: Escalating Exposure
late.annotation: This with Scourge is good. You run into the middle of the enemy team with Scourge and this does work. Also has shred and gives you even more spirit resist so you're even tankier.

late.name: Scourge

late.name: Spirit Burn

late.name: Colossus

late.name: Spellbreaker
late.annotation: Incredible against Lash, Grey Talon, and any other spirit burst characters.
